data.layout_notes: This is a standard oil and gas Daily Drilling Report (DDR) with a complex multi-section layout. The document is organized in a grid-like structure with multiple data tables and text sections distributed across the page. The layout includes: a main operations log on the left side, equipment and performance statistics on the right side, detailed BHA configuration in the lower portion, and various technical parameters (mud properties, directional data, bit information) distributed throughout. The format is typical of PEMEX (Mexican state oil company) drilling operations reports, containing comprehensive operational, safety, and technical data for the 24-hour period of February 1, 2015.

data.layout_notes: This is a complex Daily Drilling Report (DDR) for well NAVEGANTE 0001DL dated January 8, 2015. The document uses a dense multi-column layout typical of oil & gas drilling reports. Page 1 contains the main operational data organized in multiple sections including: time-based activity log (left column), operations statistics and equipment data (middle columns), lithology description, BHA configuration, and mud properties. The report documents pulling out a PDC bit with downhole motor and running in with a window mill and watermelon assembly. Page 2 contains personnel information, summary, and planned next operations. The layout maximizes information density with tables, technical specifications, and operational parameters arranged in a grid-like structure.

data.layout_notes: Standard daily drilling report format with single-column layout. Document consists of a comprehensive header section with well identification and status information, followed by detailed operational tables (critical path and parallel operations), assembly/BHA component listings, materials usage, safety statistics, HSE activities comments, and equipment test data. Tables span full page width. Most content is tabular with technical drilling parameters, depths, pressures, and equipment specifications. Pages 4-5 contain extensive text comments about HSE activities rather than structured tables.

data.layout_notes: This is a standardized daily drilling report form with a consistent single-column layout. The document begins with a comprehensive header section containing well identification, location, and operational summary information. The main body consists of multiple structured tables including: time-based operations summaries (critical path and parallel operations), technical specifications (hole sections, mud properties, BHA assembly details), resource tracking (personnel, materials, mud products), and monitoring sections (safety, weather, vessel parameters). Many tables on the final page are templates with headers but no data filled in. The report is dated October 15, 2020 (Report #39) for well 8-MRO-8-RJS on the Deepwater Mykonos rig in the LIBRA block offshore Brazil.

data.layout_notes: Standardized daily operations report for drilling operations with a form-based layout. The document is organized into multiple sections containing operational data, survey information, bit records, mud properties, BHA configuration, and cost tracking. Data is presented in a combination of labeled fields and tabular format. The layout uses a single-column structure with various sections stacked vertically, though each section may contain multiple columns of data fields. The report includes both Spanish text (operations summaries) and English technical terminology.
